experiments.procedure_text: C57BL/6J mice were intratracheally injected with 3 mg/kg BLM to induce pulmonary fibrosis, followed by tail vein injection of 20 μg MSC-exos in the treatment group.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM (Zhejiang Hisun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., China) was intratracheally injected... mice in the BLM + MSC-exos group were treated with 20 μg MSC-exos in 100 μL PBS via tail vein injection
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: random allocation into three distinct experimental groups: control group, BLM group, and BLM + MSC-exos group(n = 3).
experiments.test_system_evidence: Following a week of acclimatization, the mice underwent random allocation
experiments.route_evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM ... was intratracheally injected... treated with 20 μg MSC-exos ... via tail vein injection

endpoints.label: pulmonary fibrosis pathology
endpoints.evidence: HE staining evaluation of mouse lung tissue pathology. B. Masson staining evaluation of lung tissue pathology.

endpoints.label: α-SMA and Co1-I expression
endpoints.evidence: RT-qPCR detection of α-SMA and Co1-I expression in mouse lung tissue.

endpoints.label: EMT process markers
endpoints.evidence: RT-qPCR detection of MMP2, MMP9, N-cadherin, snail, vimentin, fibronectin, and E-cadherin expression

endpoints.label: inflammation markers
endpoints.evidence: RT-qPCR detection of NLRP3, NOD1, Caspase1, caspase11, ASC, IL-1beta, IL-18 expression in lung tissue.

substances.name: BLM
substances.evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM (Zhejiang Hisun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., China) was intratracheally injected.

substances.name: MSC-exos
substances.evidence: treated with 20 μg MSC-exos in 100 μL PBS via tail vein injection

exposure.timing: BLM induction followed by post-modeling treatment

experiments.exposure_evidence: 3 mg/kg of BLM ... intratracheally injected... after the modeling was completed ... treated with 20 μg MSC-exos
